headline: Trump threatens a major escalation in Iran after 13 nights straight of strikes
context: The U.S. continued airstrikes in Iran while Tehran launched retaliatory attacks on U.S. targets in the Gulf, as President Trump said he was close to deciding whether to launch "a massive attack."

sources.name: NPR
